free_tier.stated: anonymous guest read of 2 root directories, piv and s3b; no account and no payment

per_object_cap.stated: not published by the instance; the listing reports an unknown upstream provider

retention.stated: until the operator keeps the instance serving; no TTL is published in the API response

egress.terms: the anonymous API serves JSON over HTTPS through the challenge; no egress charge is stated

tooling: the AList/OpenList REST API (/api/public/settings, /api/me, /api/fs/list) can be read by a client that passes the automated-traffic challenge; the guest listing is keyless
chaining: a fetch substrate behind an automated-traffic challenge: the keyless guest listing can feed a cache or mirrors when the challenge is passed

limits.value: the direct endpoint answers an automated-traffic challenge with HTTP 403; a challenge-passing read route passes it and returns the guest listing

identity_cost.detail: no registration; /api/me returns a guest session with permission 0 once the challenge is passed

reliability_note: the automated-traffic challenge is passable by challenge-passing read routes: the settings API and the guest listing answer with JSON through such a route, while a direct probe is challenged

evidence.proved: HTTP 403 with an interstitial body from an automated-traffic filter; the host is behind a challenge that no fetch path in this session passed, so its capability is unestablished and it is unusable as a substrate
